rules.title: File upload saved with original filename
rules.message: Saving uploads under client-controlled names enables overwrite / extension tricks.
rules.fix: Generate server-side names; allowlist extensions and content-types; store outside web root.

rules.title: Multer .any() unrestricted upload
rules.message: Accepting any multipart field increases upload attack surface.
rules.fix: Use .single/.fields with size and type limits.
